# Artifact de Programming Model migration

Ruta nueva:

- `.migration/40-execution/functions/<FunctionName>/programming-model-v4.json`
- `.migration/40-execution/functions/<FunctionName>/programming-model-v4.md`

Registrar:

- function;
- plan/action refs;
- applicability;
- before/after programming model;
- changed files;
- registration/binding evidence;
- `actionResults`;
- validations;
- legacy residuals;
- deviations;
- blockers/review requirements;
- status.

Usar `../templates/function-migration.template.md` para la vista humana cuando sea compatible con el contrato actual.
